# desktop — workstation environment

> Platform anchor of the layer: most parts are Fedora/Linux-first, the
> windows-* parts exist because this workstation runs Windows. The adjacent
> `windows-encoding-fixes` part is the standing fix for cp1251/CRLF issues —
> read it when console output or file encodings misbehave, before writing
> any fix yourself.

## How to use it

Pick the parts that match the task from the table and read those files.
Nothing here needs to be read in full before starting.

## Parts

**Windows environment**

| Part | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `parts/windows-env/` | Windows dev-env patterns: paths, package managers (choco/winget), shell differences from Linux/macOS |
| `parts/windows-optimize/` | System optimization and cleanup: bloatware, temp/cache, autostart, services, visual tuning |
| `parts/windows-encoding-fixes/` | Console stdout encoding (cp1251 vs UTF-8), CRLF/LF when writing files — the standing fix list |

**Wine and games**

| Part | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `parts/wine-setup/` | Full Wine setup on Fedora for Windows games and repacks: wine/winetricks + MFC42, VC++ runtimes, DirectX, corefonts, extra drives |
| `parts/gta4-wine-fix/` | GTA IV under Wine playbook: RGL error, FusionFix, DXVK, shaders, windowed — diagnostics + verified fixes |

**Firefox**

| Part | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `parts/firefox-optimization/` | Firefox on Fedora/Linux for performance and stability: about:config via user.js (Betterfox/Fastfox), hardware acceleration |
| `parts/firefox-extensions/` | Verified extension bundle for speed and eye protection: YourCodecs (H.264 forcing), uBlock Origin, dark backgrounds |

**Linux kernel, swap, storage, hardware**

| Part | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `parts/zram-optimize/` | zram compressed swap on any Linux (Fedora/Arch/CachyOS/RHEL systemd-zram-generator, Ubuntu zram-tools) |
| `parts/disk-formatting/` | Format, repartition and mount disks/partitions on Fedora (ext4, btrfs, NTFS, FAT32, exFAT) |
| `parts/mic-noise-suppression/` | Fix a noisy microphone on Fedora/Linux with PipeWire: EasyEffects + RNNoise |
| `parts/fedora-warm-colors/` | Fedora GNOME (Wayland) display warmth: gamma, night light, color temperature — fix cold/washed-out look |

## Choosing

- **Windows console prints mojibake / script writes wrong line endings** →
  `parts/windows-encoding-fixes/` first; it usually already has the fix.
- **"Make Windows faster / cleaner"** → `parts/windows-optimize/`.
- **Windows game on Linux** → `parts/wine-setup/` to build the environment,
  then the game-specific part if one exists (`gta4-wine-fix`).
- **Firefox is slow or glitchy** → `parts/firefox-optimization/`, then
  `parts/firefox-extensions/` for the codec/ads/darkness stack.
- **Disk/partition work, noisy mic, cold screen colors** → the matching
  part above.
- **Look-and-feel theming (make X look like Windows 11)** → the `themes`
  router, not here.

## Boundary

Security-related Windows work (AD, Kerberos, identity attacks) lives in the
security skills (`windows-ad` and siblings). Pure terminal-emulator and
file-manager theming lives in `themes`.
